notes.title: Scenographic Editor : make your landscapes public!
notes.content:
Since the recent release of the Scenographic Editor (http://app.ryzom.com/app_forum/index.php?page=topic/view/26321), each player has had the opportunity to create his own sets (called scenes) on a specific island accessible from a Ring teleport (http://app.ryzom.com/app_forum/index.php?page=topic/view/26338).

http://app.ryzom.com/app_notes/assets/80/2MDffcOA_screen1.png

These scenes, until now, could only be seen in game by their creator, as for example this one (http://app.ryzom.com/app_forum/index.php?page=topic/view/26346), shared on the Ryzom forum.

https://c1.staticflickr.com/1/556/32002112475_44fde68b5e_o.png

That changes from now on.  Each scene creator will now be able to select one of them to make public with a simple click in the window of the Editor.
This opening is global for the moment, in other words everyone can go to the island of the player to see the scene he/she has made public. Later it will be possible to invite specific guest players and to make additional scenes public without limit.

The public scenes will be accessible via the Ring teleports, with, at first:

- an input field allowing the search for the scenery of a player;
- 10 scenes chosen at random for those who like surprises.

The following improvements are planned:

- a "Shared Scenes" tab;
- a "Visited Scenes" tab displaying the 20 most recently visited scenes, whose rating will be possible;
- a "Ranking" tab which will display, at first, the 20 best-rated scenes.

We remain at your disposal for any further information and wish you a good game on Atys!

The Ryzom Team

P.S. To help us improve the Scenographic Editor, we invite you to share your feelings and requests for improvements here (http://app.ryzom.com/app_forum/index.php?page=topic/view/26487/).

notes.title: Patch 3.1.0 - 2016-12-23
notes.content:
A client sidepatch and a restart of the game server are planned on December 23rd, 2016 in order to implement the following additions and fixes:

        Fix crash when <select> element was without <form>
        Update liblzma
        Add free-view mouse tablet mode option

notes.title: Atysmas events
notes.content:
Creator of the event: Ryzom Team.
Type of event: OOC events.
Appropriate Levels: All.

Dates of the event: from december 23rd 2016 to january 8th 2017 included.
Meeting Place: Atysmas village and everywhere on Atys.

Homins concerned: All. 
Synopsis: Atysmas is here with its magic atmosphere and events!
To learn more: http://app.ryzom.com/app_forum/index.php?page=topic/view/26260/2#2 

-----

[b]Atysmas calendar[/b]

A sign listing the festivities is displayed in every capital and in the Atymas Village.

[u]From now through 8 January inclusive:[/u]
Look for the very big gift in the capitals or in Marauder Camp and open it! This Advent Calendar should have nice presents for you.

[u]26 December 20:00 UTC:[/u]
Atysmas Story telling.

[u]From 23 December to 8 January inclusive:[/u]
4 permanent events are available:
    - Grinch or Elf? (cooperative game) – solo game with social interaction
    - The biggest of all snowmen – solo game with both solo and group results
    - Yubohoho – collective (group) game
    - Catch up with Ronny – race using the new race application

If you like surprises, look on the ground all over Atys. The Sint sometimes drops gifts from his sleigh. You should also look for the chests that Lutrykins sometimes set under an Atysmas Tree!

Of course, other surprises could happen throughout all of Atysmas!

Merry Atysmas to all!

-----

[b][Event] Atysmas Story Telling[/b]

You notice it by a more cheerful attitude around the campfires of the city guards. You notice it in the smiling faces of the children running around. You notice it by the eager Yubos pawing in the dust, fattening up for the winter. You notice it by many things. Atysmas is coming!

Come to the new Lutrykin Atysmas Village at 8 h, Pluvia 23, 2nd AC, 2591(*) for Atysmas Story Telling! The Lutrykin Storyteller will host the gathering. Come tell us a tale, or just come to listen to the amazing stories told by other assembled homins. Enjoy a beautiful Atysmas gathering with a mixture of funny, contemplative and inspirational tales and poems. Let all inhabitants of Atys be part of your fantasy and share an Atysian story.

We are looking forward to a delightful evening with you and your favourite stories.(**)

(*) [OOC] Lundi 26 Décembre 20:00 CET

-----

[b][Event] Grinch or Elf?[/b]

[u]Description[/u]:
Lutrykins have opened a workshop in each Atys nation, in which they create Atysmas gifts.

Will you choose to be an Elf and help Lutrykins by carrying the completed gifts to a special area next to the workshop? For this, talk to the NPC in a workshop, he’ll give you a gift that will appear as a virtual item in the “Special” part of your bag. Then go in the special area as explained by the NPC, and click on the virtual item in your special bag to put the gift on the floor, just where you are standing. You’ll then get a random reward.

Or will you choose to be a Grinch by destroying the gifts moved to the special area by the Elves? These gifts are attackable and can be destroyed, but they have a lot more HPs than the usual ones. They drop a random loot.

Note that traps (see below) and presents have a cooldown and only one present can be carried at the same time.

[u]Scores[/u]:
- For Elves: Placing a present gives you a positive score (+1 for a small gift, +2 for a medium one, + 3 for a big one). Elves can buy some traps to block the Grinches using their positive scores.
- For Grinches: Destroying a present gives you a negative score (-1 for a small gift, -2 for a medium one, -3 for a big one).

Grinches loose some negative scores if they fall into a trap and can’t loot the trapped present.Note that it’s possible to be sometimes kind, sometimes evil, you are not forced to always act as an elf or as a grinch.

[u]Rewards[/u]:
Elves rewards:
- 3 stages of titles according to the positive score (30, 60, 120);
- 1 new reward (equip-able ginger-yubo) for the last stage.Note that a won title will not be lost by elf players if they  buy some traps after having won the title.

Grinches rewards:
- 3 stages of titles according to the negative score (-10, -20, -50);
- 1 new reward (same than that of elves) for the last stage. 

-----

[b][Event] The biggest of all snowmen[/b]

This year, as winter sets in, very numerous mini-snowmen leave to discover the surface of Atys.

Hominas and homins of Silan, Fyros, Matis, Trykers, Zoraï, Marauders, Rangers or Independents, you can engage in competition to create the greatest of all snowmen!

[u]How to play?[/u]

1 - Target each of the mini-snowmen moving at the surface of Atys in order to harvest from them a fresh snowball. For this, you will have to place yourself less than 4 meters from them. A message in SYS. INFO will inform you that you have collected a fresh snowball, which will appear in your “Special” bag.Each snowman will provide only one snowball per participant.

2 - Go to the Atysmas village to deposit the fresh snowballs you got in the barrel provided for this purpose.At the first deposit you will be asked to define the team (nation or organization) you wish to compete for : “Fyros”, “Matis”, “Trykers”, “Zoraï”, “Marauders”, “Rangers” or “Silan and Independents”.

The Lutrykins will then use this snow to create, fatten and grow taller the super-snowmen present in the village as well as their counterparts in front of the cities.

Seek carefully, the mini-snowmen wander everywhere, in every region of the surface of Atys. There are 679 mini-snowmen on Atys: 41 on Silan, 164 in the Desert, 165 in the Forest (Marauder camp included), 164 in the Lakes, 124 in the Jungle, 21 in Almati. Will you find them all?

[u]Rankings[/u]:
There will be two rankings:
- Rank of the 7 teams according to the final size of their super-snowmen;
- Rank of the participants according to the number of snowballs put down.

[u]Rewards[/u]:
- For the 20 first homins of each team: an equipable ginger-homin;
- For the 60 first of each team: a giant snowman for apartment;
- For all the participants: a very small snowman for apartment;
- 4 stages of titles according to the number of mini-snowmen found (40, 100, 300, 500);

-----

[b][Event] Yubohoho[/b]

Watch out for huntable snowmen all over Atys. What is behind this strange phenomenon? Find out during the whole of Atysmas! [/b]

-----

[b][Event] Catch up with Ronny[/b]

The Lutrykins Miep and Beggy goofed up and now they need your help to save Atysmas!Meet Miep near Yrkanis to get more information.

"Catch up with Ronny" is a mounted race around the whole of Atys (250 level regions included), using the new race app. The 10 homins with the best times will win a new reward (a gubani statue), and all the other participants will get a consolation gift.

notes.title: Anlor Winn events - 10/28/2016 to 11/06/2016
notes.content:
[u]Creator of the event[/u]: Ryzom Team.
[u]Type of event[/u]: Various OOC events.
[u]Appropriate levels[/u]: All.

[u]Date of the event[/u]: From [time]2016-10-28 19:00 UTC[/time] to [time]2016-11-06 23:00 UTC[/time].
[u]Expected duration[/u]: 9 days.
[u]Meeting place[/u]: All over Atys (Silan included).

[u]Homins concerned[/u]: All.
[u]Synopsis[/u]: Anlor Winn, the Evil Wind, is blowing across Atys. Terrible things could happen.
[u]To learn more[/u]: http://app.ryzom.com/app_forum/index.php?page=topic/view/26052 

* * *

[i]The wind is blowing.
The wind gets stronger.
The wind roars and makes homins tremble in their shelters.
Go hide yourselves away, you fools, because the Ill Wind is coming. And who knows what it brings under its wings of misfortune?
Listen to the cursed laughter of the Anlor Winn. Mouah hah hah hah.... [/i]

* * *

Let's discover what Anlor Winn will bring us this year, between Friday, 28 October 21:00:00 CEST (20.7 hours to go) and Monday, 7 November 08:00:00 CET (1 week to go):

[b]- "60 seconds" (Main Land):[/b]

[u]Game rules[/u]:
An NPC is standing next to a special vortex in each nation.
Start the game by talking to the NPC in the nation of your choice.
The game starts with the spawn of a level 1 mob. You have to kill it in less than 60 seconds. If you succeed, you level up and have to kill a level 2 mob that has 5% more HP than the old one, always in less than 60 seconds. Then same for level 3, level 4, etc. There is no maximum level limit, but after a certain level the mob gets so many HPs that it is hard to kill it in less than 60 seconds! How high for a level will you achieve?

[u]Saving[/u]:
Your levels are saved every 10 levels. If you die before reaching the threshold of the next higher, you'll restart from the last saved level.
Ex: if you lose at level 23, you'll restart from level 20.
The type of mob changes after each save.

[u]Rewards[/u]:
A new reward will be unlocked for every 50 levels you gain.


[b]- "Ghosts of Anlor Winn" (Silan):[/b]

[u]Game rules[/u]:
20 ghosts haunt Silan. Target them (5 meters maximum) to obtain a ghost spirit in your “Special” inventory (second tab in your inventory windows). 

[u]Rewards[/u]:
When you have gathered the 20 ghosts spirits, they transform themselves into a title and a special reward for your future apartment in Main Land.


[b]- “Kill the Pumpkins” (Silan and Main Land):[/b]

[u]Game Rules[/u]:
Mysterious burning objects are washing over Atys and creating strange light sources that move on the Bark. Hurry to trample them before they set fire to the fur of a yubo!
But don't cry victory too soon since the impish lights, once extinguished, can:
- disappear in a small puff of smoke and turn into pumpkins, which you'll have to catch before they escape;
- explode and turn into pumpkins, which you'll have to then frighten to death;
- turn into pumpkins, which you'll have to then chase to eat a piece of them.
Trample and make disappear as many pumpkins as possible! Be brave, fear may not be on your side!

[u]Rewards[/u]:
A title and three apartment objects, each one being won after a random (and increasing for each level)  number of  killed pumpkins.

[b]- "Yubo Golf" (Main Land):[/b]

[u]Game Rule[/u]:
Imagine a golf game on Atys, where a yubo is used as a ball... and where the hole is replaced with a hungry kincher! Come and discover, or discover again, the thousand and one ways to feed a yubo to a kitin!
Would you manage to become legendary by smashing the scores of the other players?

[b]- "Yubo zombies" (Main Land):[/b]

[u]Game Rules[/u]:
Anlor Winn cast a spell on some friendly animals. They've turned into zombies and will attack you. If you're bitten, you'll turn into a zombie also! (You'll get a "Zombie" title, without any change on your character.)

[u]Rewards[/u]:
A title and apartment objects depending on the number of killed zombies.


All of the Ryzom Team wishes you a Happy Anlor Winn!

notes.title: Ryzom will move to a real Free to Play/Freemium concept soon!
notes.content:
Hello,

We are working to move the game to a true [b]Free to Play / Freemium[/b] concept, in answer to the feedback you have shared with us on our forums and on Steam:

- [b][u]All accounts will have a free to play access, even the unsubscribed ones.[/u][/b]
Our main goal is to give all the players choosing not to pay (or not to pay anymore) the same basic gameplay required to enjoy all the game. That means that unsubcribed players will still be able to play even if they are not subscribed anymore, with free to play rights, which is not the case at the moment.

- [b][u]Paying for Premium option will permit more gameplay rights.[/u][/b]
Moving to Premium option will offer more gameplay possibilities, such as double experience points, more storage capacity, higher allowed level of equipment...
Removing an account from the Premium option will allow the player to go on playing with this account. It will, however, be moved back to the Free to Play option.

We will add more details once the developers have finished their work and we are ready to implement this new feature. This is in our high priority to-do list. 

Have a nice day on Atys!

Ryzom Team

notes.title: Ryzom is on Steam!
notes.content:
We take great pride in announcing that Ryzom is online on the Steam platform beginning May 6th, 2016!

[img]http://app.ryzom.com/app_web_assets/assets/80/capsule_lg.png[/img]

[b][u]Significant enhancements made on the occasion of the release of Ryzom on Steam[/u]   [/b]
     
[u]Upgrading visual effects[/u]
        
- Better rendering (FXAA, anisotropic filtering, impovement of bloom)
- Rectification and regeneration of all textures
- Optimus support for NVIDIA cards

[u]Technical enhancements[/u]
- Implementation of OpenGL 3D as the default driver for all platforms and graphic cards
- Updating all external libraries
- Support of 64-bit architecture for the latest version for all platforms
- Improved compiler support (GCC 5, MinGW, Visual C++ 2012, 2013 and 2015)
- Upgraded support of HTML in the game (new tags, abolition of dependance on libwww, patches, etc.)
- New version of the multiplatform configuration program
- Support of GIF image format
- Support for unicode filenames under Windows
        
[u]Improvement of security[/u]
- Hashing passwords in SHA-512 instead of DES
- Updating of SSLcertificate
                                
[u]Ease of use and other improvements[/u]
- Ingame text enhancement
- Random name generator for character creation
- Numerous optimizations, enhancements and bug corrections
- Fixing of a number of warnings
- Use of all cores by default
- Detecting the amount of memory on the graphics card and use of appropriate quality
- Vertical sync supported on all platforms
- Use of XAudio2 as audio driver by default on Windows
- Major reconstruction of the interface to include a WYSIWYG editor
- Support for new styles for fonts
- New links for support and forums
- New Ryzom icon
- Improved appearance of boots in combination with caster pants
- Adding the date in the file names for screenshots
